sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The soldier has type-2 mandibles and a head capsule smaller than in O. gibberorum, O. heberi, O. insignis, O. okeyma, O. orthognathus and O. uncimandibularis; it differs from the other species in the long and slender cutting edge at the apex of the inner mandibular margin. It differs from O. macrocephalus in the curved lateral margins of the head capsule, and from O. brevipilosus in the denser short hairs on the ventral surface.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Sides of the head irregular in dorsal view and slightly convergent anteriorly. Dorsal tubercle slightly prominent in lateral view, situated behind the lateral projection. Mandibles type 2, with a tooth-like process on the proximal half. Head capsule with scattered setae and short hairs, denser ventrally, minute hairs in the apical region. Postmentum with setae. Pronotum with short hairs and setae, more numerous on the margins; posterior margins of the mesonotum and metanotum with setae; abdominal tergites and sternites densely setose, the posterior margin of the sternites with erect setae.
